entries.label: CO  34  Pirate Hand Map

tags.subject: treasure-map sketch with X-mark
tags.placement: back of the right hand and wrist

entries.description: A single-hand sketch only, sitting on the back of the right hand and curling onto the wrist. The motif is a rough treasure-map fragment with a bold X mark, scattered island blobs, dashed coastlines and a small skull-like glyph, drawn in loose, sketch-like ink.

entries.label: CO  31  Nexus Hands Female

tags.subject: stylised glyph crest with floral accent
tags.placement: back of both hands and the inner forearm-cuff

entries.description: A pair of compact glyph crests sit on the back of each hand: a small four-petal flower set above a hooked tendril, with a curled accent below the knuckles. Heavy ribbon-like strokes continue down the inner wrist and forearm as an irregular cuff.

entries.label: CO  32  Dalish Hands  1  Female

tags.subject: dotted vine bands
tags.placement: outer edge of both hands, running from wrist to fingertip

entries.description: A stippled vine of paired dots and short curves runs along the outer edge of each hand, climbing from the wrist over the back of the thumb toward the fingertip. A second sparser dotted curve traces the inner wrist, leaving the centre of the hand bare.

entries.label: CO  33  Dalish Hands  2  Female

tags.subject: stippled tribal vines with leaf cluster
tags.placement: back of both hands, knuckle base, and full forearm-cuff

entries.description: Multiple horizontal bands of dot-and-dash vines wrap the wrist and back of each hand, with a small leaf-and-branch cluster rising up the outer forearm. The lines stack like jewellery bracelets and continue down toward the knuckle base as fine stippled dashes.

entries.label: CO  36  Corruption Hand Base Female

tags.subject: ragged ink blot creeping up the hand
tags.style: solid ink with torn organic edges
tags.placement: outer side of the right hand, wrist and forearm

entries.description: A single-hand fill of solid black ink that climbs the outer side of the right hand from the forearm to the knuckle base, with torn, jagged edges that look like spreading rot or shadow. The thumb side of the hand is fully consumed while the fingers stay clean.

entries.label: CO  36  Corruption Hand L 2  Female

tags.subject: demonic glyph row
tags.placement: outer side of the right wrist with a small hook on the upper hand

entries.description: A vertical column of small angular runes runs down the outer wrist of the right hand, capped by a curled hook-glyph just above the thumb on the back of the hand. The marks read like a short cursed inscription set into the skin rather than a tribal band.

entries.label: CO  38  Mitsukami Hands Female

tags.subject: spiral and eye-rune pair
tags.placement: back of both hands at the wrist crease and just above the knuckles

entries.description: A flat spiral sits on the back of each wrist, fed by a short tendril, and a second mark — a stylised slit-eye inside a horseshoe — sits just above the knuckle base. The pair reads like a paired occult sigil rather than a continuous band.

entries.label: CO  39  Runic Shade Hands Female

tags.subject: vertical column of small runes
tags.placement: outer edge of both hands from wrist to little finger

entries.description: A narrow strip of small angular runes runs along the outer pinky-side edge of each hand, from the wrist down to the base of the little finger. The glyphs are tightly stacked but the rest of the hand and the back of the knuckles stay completely bare.

entries.id: CO 40 Feranas Left Hand L1 Female
entries.label: CO  40  Feranas Left Hand L 1  Female

tags.subject: single-hand swirl tendril
tags.placement: back of the right hand and wrist

entries.description: A single-hand mark on the back of the right hand: a tall hooked tendril with a coiled spiral terminal rises from the wrist toward the knuckles, with a smaller separate spiral curl sitting below it on the wrist. The other hand is left bare.

entries.id: CO 40 Feranas Left Hand L2 Female
entries.label: CO  40  Feranas Left Hand L 2  Female

tags.subject: single-hand swirl tendril, denser variant
tags.placement: back of the right hand, knuckle base and wrist

entries.description: A single-hand design only, with the right hand carrying a denser stack of tribal curls that climbs from the wrist over the back of the hand and onto the knuckle ridge. Multiple coiled spirals interlock with hook-tipped tendrils for a thicker tier.

entries.id: CO 40 Feranas Left Hand L3 Female
entries.label: CO  40  Feranas Left Hand L 3  Female

tags.subject: dotted vine outline
tags.placement: back of the right hand and outer wrist

entries.description: A single-hand mark only, on the right hand: a faint dotted outline of the L2 tendril, rendered as tiny stipple dots that climb from the wrist toward the knuckles with a small spiral terminal. Reads as a faded scar of the heavier design.

entries.label: CO  42  Stripes Hands Female

tags.subject: animal-stripe brush slashes
tags.placement: back of both hands at the knuckle base, fanning over the fingers

entries.description: Five short, vertical brush-stroke stripes sit at the base of the knuckles on each hand, fanning slightly toward the fingertips. The strokes are thick and slightly tapered, giving an animal-fur-pattern look across the back of the hand.

entries.label: CO  43  Natura Hands Base Female

tags.subject: ragged ink overgrowth
tags.style: solid ink with torn organic edges
tags.placement: outer side of both hands, wrists and lower forearm-cuff

entries.description: A solid-fill creeping mass of ink runs up the outer thumb-side of each hand, the wrist and the lower forearm, with shredded, torn edges that look like spreading bark or rot. The fingers and the centre of the back of the hand stay clear.

entries.label: CO  43  Natura Hands L 2  Female

tags.subject: ragged ink fragments with sharp claws
tags.placement: outer side of both hands, wrists and lower forearm-cuff

entries.description: A broken-up version of the heavy overgrowth: solid black shards with hooked, claw-tipped extensions wrap the outer side of each hand, the wrist and the lower forearm. The shapes look like jagged ink-scales rather than a continuous fill.

entries.label: CO  43  Natura Hands L 3  Female

tags.subject: etched runic and dotted detailing
tags.placement: outer side of both hands, wrists and lower forearm-cuff

entries.description: A delicate stippled overlay made of tiny dotted runes, sun-disc glyphs, leaf clusters and short hatch bars, arranged along the outer hand and wrist where the heavier tier sits. The detail reads as a fine etched continuation of an existing ink mass.

entries.id: CO 43 Natura Hands L3 Variant Female
entries.label: CO  43  Natura Hands L 3  Variant Female

layers.texture: Actors\Character\Overlays\Community Overlays\CO 2\43 Hands L3 Variant F.dds

tags.subject: etched runic and dotted detailing, alt motif
tags.placement: outer side of both hands, wrists and lower forearm-cuff

entries.description: A near-identical fine-stipple overlay to the standard L3 but with a small flower-and-curl cluster swapped in along the forearm cuff. Same dotted runes, sun-disc and leaf cluster motifs along the outer hand and wrist.

entries.label: CO  46  High Kraisas Hands Female

tags.subject: angular tribal crest
tags.placement: outer wrist and back of the hand at the knuckle base, both hands

entries.description: A chunky angular tribal crest sits on each outer wrist, formed of stacked zig-zag bars and a hooked talon-shape that reaches up onto the knuckle base of the hand. Heavy negative-space slits run inside the strokes.

entries.label: CO  48  Faeri Hands Female

tags.subject: filigree wrist band
tags.placement: outer wrist of both hands, running down onto the lower forearm

entries.description: A long narrow filigree band wraps the outer wrist of each hand and trails down onto the lower forearm, made of small coiled scrolls, paired curls and tiny diamond accents. The hand itself stays bare and the design reads as etched jewellery.

entries.label: CO Extra Vortex Hand Female

tags.subject: concentric whorl with rib bars
tags.placement: back of the left hand and the inner wrist

entries.description: A single-hand design only, on the left hand. A round whorl ringed by short rib-bars sits on the back of the hand near the knuckle base, and a larger bell-shaped whorl with concentric rings sits on the inner wrist below it. Reads like wood-grain rings.
